'''Greel''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who ran a [[Greel's speeder shop|speeder shop]] in [[Ardak Point]] in [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. His shop was used as a front by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].<ref name="TOR:AFoT"/>
